scope: Full unchanged included sets; explicit publication/preprint equivalence only. Download submission never counts before material validation.

definitions.available_main_text: Identity-checked local main-text original exists; does not establish complete extraction or scientific comprehension.
definitions.edition_policy_satisfied: An available main-text material is assigned to a published, accepted or preprint edition; this is weaker than exact revision satisfaction.
definitions.strict_requested_version: Only explicit requested_version_id targets actually present in active acquisition jobs; zero targets means not tested, not 100% success.
definitions.latest_catalogued_repository_version: Highest numbered exact revision actually present in this catalog for that repository work. This does not establish the current latest version at every provider.
definitions.text_extract_available: At least some nonempty extracted original text is available, not a guarantee of lossless whole-document extraction.
definitions.xml_navigation: Original JATS XML with numbered logical sections; never PDF physical pages.
